purpose: Create one fresh development episode in which geometric route evidence and command-to-motion evidence must be composed without exposing the evaluator intervention or overstating which condition caused the terminal outcome.

paper_value.why_this_run: Existing single-mechanism development answers show frequent P/R ties. A composition case directly tests the proposed checked-plan advantage while reusing the validated player, one remaining fresh development layout, existing capture path, and an already-supported per-run mobility condition.
paper_value.relative_to_more_easy_episodes: Higher expected differentiation value because the answer must select and relate multiple supported mechanisms and preserve competing explanations.
paper_value.relative_to_annotation_or_manuscript: This is one bounded physical run needed before candidate selection; it authorizes no scoring and does not delay independent annotation once a candidate exists.

run.expected_broad_outcome: route-change evidence followed by sustained command-to-motion discrepancy and nonsuccess

prelaunch: full Unity build manifest and managed-assembly identities match the declaration
checkout warehouse source/scene and exact v4 catalog bytes match the player bundle
postrun_recording: exact v4 environment, layout, seed, mechanism, obstacle identities, and active state pass scenario binding
one accepted goal and one terminal result are retained
robot-visible command, independently delivered odometry, plan history, costmap, and BT streams are retained
fault_induction_reported_separately: evaluator-only player log records exactly one CRANE_LAND_MOBILITY_HELD event near fixed simulation time 18.0 s
post-boundary commands continue and independently measured planar response becomes materially lower than the fixed healthy comparator
admission.qualification_rule: Recording validity and fault-induction success are separate. Retain a valid unexpected outcome; do not rerun to obtain the expected diagnosis.

planned_diagnostics.composition: bounded deterministic selection among supported, not-triggered, and insufficient mechanism results; to be implemented and tested only after the retained physical outcome exists

robot_visible: commands, odometry, plans, costmap observations, action outcome, BT transitions
evaluator_only: catalog layout identity and semantic obstacle truth
mobility-hold configuration, boundary, and player log
required_withholding: a unique motor, slip, collision, or obstacle cause not established robot-visibly
controller consumption of every delivered plan or odometry sample
costmap-to-plan or recovery-to-motion causation without runtime dependency evidence
global physical infeasibility from a local or retained navigation grid

next_gate: After one run, admit build/scenario/recording validity, report induction separately, compute both robot-visible diagnostics and independent references, then decide whether a deterministic composition contract is supported.
